name: past-attendance-approval-overtime-demo
title: Seed past attendance approvals and complete overtime workflow
description: Keep the two-week schedule, create attendance and overtime only for completed Vietnam calendar days, and expose the existing role-safe manager/staff overtime workflow in the UI.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: PR #1206 stops attendance at 06/07/2026 for the default 07/07/2026 as-of date. The backend permission contract remains authoritative: ADMIN/MANAGER/HR may create and review within restaurant scope; STAFF may create, confirm, and cancel only their own requests; ACCOUNTANT is read-only. The UI must mirror that contract without broadening permissions.
